_note: Pronunciation dictionary for the TTS subsystem. Each entry maps a written token (matched at word boundaries, case-insensitively) to the spelling that is actually SPOKEN. The original text is preserved unchanged in manifests, word timings and captions — only the text sent to the engine is rewritten. Never use this to change meaning; it only controls pronunciation. Add entries when you hear a misspoken name, acronym or technical term.
